question: Should OpenClaw accept multi-role memory slots as the product/API direction for memory composition, using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the current implementation path?
rationale: The request adds persisted config surface and plugin runtime semantics across memory, agent scope, doctor, and plugin lifecycle behavior, so it needs maintainer API intent rather than a strict bug-fix lane.

options.title: Sponsor PR 88504
options.body: Keep this issue open and drive the existing PR through conflict repair, upgrade proof, and final review.

options.title: Stage a narrower API
options.body: Keep this issue open but require a smaller first slice such as dreaming coexistence or slot-owner groundwork before full role slots.

options.title: Decline role slots for now
options.body: Document the supported single-slot behavior and close or redirect the implementation PR if maintainers do not want this direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor PR 88504
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and drive the existing PR through conflict repair, upgrade proof, and final review.

likelyOwner.reason: The current slot/config/runtime paths blame to recent work under this owner, making them the best available product/API routing candidate from history.
